data.title: Festival to net B1.4bn
data.description: Phuket expects this year's Vegetarian Festival to generate at least 1.4 billion baht in economic activity as more than 140,000 visitors are forecast to attend.

data.title: New app 'eases' Thai immigration
data.description: Foreign visitors to Thailand will have easier access to immigration and travel services through the newly launched Thai Immigration (THIM) Application, Pol Lt Gen Panumas Boonyalug, Immigration Bureau commissioner, said.

data.title: Spanish chef loses appeal against life sentence
data.description: The Appeal Court has upheld a life sentence for Spanish chef Daniel Sancho Bronchalo for the premeditated murder of Colombian surgeon Edwin Arrieta Arteaga on Koh Phangan.

data.title: Court to rule on ballot barcodes
data.description: Attention is turning to Monday's Constitutional Court ruling on barcodes and QR codes on election ballots, with a former election commissioner outlining four possible outcomes, ranging from no change to a fresh general election.

data.title: Cancer plans face funding shortfall
data.description: HONG KONG: Funding for national cancer control plans remains critically insufficient, with fewer than 10% fully funded worldwide, the president of the Union for International Cancer Control (UICC) has warned.

data.title: Court upholds ruling disqualifying NBTC chairman
data.description: The Central Administrative Court upheld a ruling disqualifying National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) chairman Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck from office, finding that his work at a state-run hospital breached eligibility rules.

data.title: Man City found guilty of Premier League charges, set to appeal: reports
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Manchester City have been found guilty of all but one of 115 Premier League charges for breaching financial regulations, according to reports on Friday, in a ruling that will send shockwaves through English football.

data.title: Daytime Russian attacks kill seven in Kyiv
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian strikes on Kyiv during the day killed seven people on Friday, including a 14-year-old boy, local authorities said, as Ukraine's leader disclosed that Donald Trump had approved licences for Patriot air-defence systems.

data.title: Russia not preparing for conflict with Europe, Putin says
data.description: SAINT PETERSBURG - Russia is not preparing for "any kind" of conflict with Europe, President Vladimir Putin said Friday, following warnings from some European NATO members of potential Russian attacks on the alliance's territory.

data.title: Trump, Xi inspect founding documents of US democracy to close summit
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump took Xi Jinping to see the founding documents of American democracy on Friday as the Chinese leader's state visit wrapped up with more pageantry but limited progress.

data.title: Six missing after building blast in historic Athens district

data.title: Conditions in Western Sahara camps ‘deteriorating’
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - The United Nations’ top official for refugees warned on Friday that conditions for long-displaced people in Western Sahara were getting worse and that their humanitarian needs were starkly underfunded.

data.title: Security Council condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia

data.title: Takraw joy and heartbreak for Thailand

data.title: Thai footballers target semis, China stand in way

data.title: Hua Hin ready to clear beach after decades-long dispute
data.description: Authorities in Hua Hin are stepping up their efforts to clear all houses and buildings encroaching on a public beach to resolve a decades-long dispute, in the face of defiance from some owners.

data.title: Retired general’s son sets house ablaze, takes own life
data.description: The son of a retired army general took his own life after setting fire to his home and shooting at firefighters before police could enter to discover a huge cache of military-grade weapons and explosives at his two-storey property in Bang Phlat district of Bangkok on Friday morning.

data.title: PTT Group Drives Thailand’s Hub Ambition at Gastech 2026
data.description: PTT Group showcases Thailand's energy potential at Gastech 2026 (Sept 14 to 17 at Bitec, Bangkok), supporting the country as a regional energy hub and a key global liquefied natural gas (LNG) player. Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Energy Minister Akanat Promphan joined senior officials at the opening of PTT’s exhibition.

data.title: The Art of Falling: How a Thai Teenager Is Helping Youth Rise with Confidence
data.description: Young people today are taught to strive for achievement, but are perhaps given fewer opportunities to become comfortable with uncertainty.
